label: Dell OptiPlex 9010 small form factor
description: 2012 Ivy Bridge-era SFF desktop, Core i5/i7 3000-series, Intel 82579LM Gigabit RJ45, no Wi-Fi.
notes: 1GbE RJ45 (Intel 82579LM) onboard, no wireless option fitted in the field. Legacy 1000BASE-T host that still auto-negotiates down to 100M against old switches - good for mixed-speed lab scenarios.
